responsibility: Defines the Visium backend’s RTL constraint language used by instruction recognition and reload. It assigns machine constraint letters to specific register classes and special registers such as MDB, MDC, FP registers, sibcall-capable registers, and fixed low registers, and it defines the immediate integer and floating-point ranges accepted directly by Visium insns, so patterns in visium.md can discriminate legal operands during matching, reload, and assembly emission.
